policy: Prefer adapting current verified complete RPH; keep all standards, measurable objective, criteria, official source references, materials, duration, assessment and teacher metadata; supplement only missing phase purpose. phases.engagement: Guru mainkan bunyi hujan dan loceng tanpa menunjukkan gambar; murid meneka sumber.
